source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
For each inspection log, obtain information regarding:

   • The date of the audit

   • The name of the worker performing the audit

   • The results of the audit

3. Add this information into a text file
4. Save and share the text file with your colleagues
5. Create a checklist of tasks that were not completed
6. Check off all the completed tasks
7. Add the tasks in the checklist to the text file
8. Review the text file for any errors
9. Save and share the text file with your colleagues
10. Review the text file for any issues
11. Save and share the text file with your colleagues

## Checklist:
- [x] Accurate records and documentation
- [x] Safety audits
- [x] Industrial safety inspections
- [x] Industrial safety audits
- [x] Safety checklists
- [x] Safety audits checklist
